title: Yellowstone sound library - Bald Eagle - 002
author: NPS & MSU Acoustic Atlas/Jennifer Jerrett
changes: Bald eagle (Haliaeetus leucocephalus) calling from a tree near Yellowstone Lake: a series of four high, chattering whistles. Trimmed to 24.80–27.35 s of the original, mixed to mono, silence trimmed, loudness-normalised (≈ −18 dBFS RMS, peak ≤ −1 dBFS), 10 ms fade-in / 120 ms fade-out, encoded as 96 kbps mono MP3. Public-domain field recording from the Yellowstone National Park sound library (National Park Service & MSU Acoustic Atlas). Left channel used because the stereo channels partly cancel when mixed.
